abstract: Obtaining quantitative measurements from live 3D microscopy remains difficult to implement across research settings, particularly without profound image-analysis expertise. We present BEHAV3D-Explorer, an interactive, user-friendly platform that uses natural-language guidance to help users select analysis strategies, tune parameters and configure workflows. BEHAV3D-Explorer enables time-resolved behavioral classification and integrates it with morphological, interaction and functional analyses, thereby connecting dynamic readouts to yield interpretable results across imaging applications.
